title: The Agie post has a generic name: rename "Native wire EDM job files" to "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
## What is wrong

#3537 (PR #3598) renamed the post "Agie native wire EDM" to "Native wire EDM job files". It also changed about 58 refusals from "Agie requires X" to "The native wire EDM job requires X". The wire EDM PRs of 23-25 Nov (#2955 to #2999) used the same words.

This post serves one control only. It writes AgieVision ISO, SBR and SBL job files for the AGIECUT Classic 2S. It refuses all other machines (`crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:83`, `:88`). The generic name makes it look like a feature for all wire machines. The user cannot see that it is for the AgieVision control only.

The opposite problem also occurs, but less often. One generic wire page shows Agie text to users of all wire posts.

Examples on `origin/main` at `d80dc6944`:

- The post name: `crates/app/src/posting_agie.rs:21` `"Native wire EDM job files"`, and `assets/posts/agie-native.cps:3`.
- The `.cps` option group "Wire EDM technology" (`agie-native.cps:10`). Only this post has the option.
- About 50 refusals and UI texts, for example:
  - "The native wire EDM job requires a Wire Contour" (`operation/agie_profile.rs:28`)
  - "Native wire EDM post blocked - ..." (`posting_agie.rs:142`)
  - "A new job folder will contain the native controller files." (`ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog_tabs.rs:36`)
- The geometry crate names the post in a refusal: `crates/geometry/src/die_opening.rs:22`.
- The generic Wire page shows the hint "Agie open cuts require both clamps ..." for each open cut, for all wire posts (`ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:239`). Only the AgieVision post reads the two check boxes above the hint (`agie_profile.rs:146`).

## The rule

- Use the control name only for a thing that works only for that control. The post name follows the pattern of the other wire posts, brand + process + control: "Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21)" and "Generic ISO Wire EDM". The AgieVision post becomes "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)". Write "AGIECUT Classic 2S" for the machine.
- Do not use "native wire EDM", "native controller" or "the control" alone for AgieVision-only items.
- Do not put an Agie name on a generic wire EDM item. Wire Contour, DXF chain selection, arc offset, wire laws, verification, skims and DXF import are generic.
- A machine name is never a feature or an operation name. This keeps the maintainer's decision on #3537.

Decision: this rule changes the post name that #3537 chose. The rename was agreed on Discord on 25 Nov 2026, with the name "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)". The name keeps "Wire EDM" because Agie also builds die-sinking machines, and it matches the other wire post names.

## The classes, with examples

- **A. Agie-specific and named Agie. Keep these.**
  - Machine file `agiecut-classic-2s.mch` and model `AGIECUT CLASSIC 2S`.
  - Condition ids `AGIE_QN2` and `AGIE_BERCO_RA035`.
  - MCP tools `create_agie_inspection` and `export_agie_inspection`. CLI `export-agie-inspection`.
  - Modules `crates/post/src/agie/`, `agie_setup/`, `posting_agie.rs`, `operation/agie_profile.rs`.
  - Golden folders `golden/nc/agie-native/` and `golden/agie-setup/`. Folder `examples/agie/`.
- **B. Agie-specific but with a generic name. Rename these.**
  - Post name: "Native wire EDM job files" -> "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)".
  - Refusals: "The native wire EDM job requires X" -> "The Agie Wire EDM job requires X".
  - UI: "native controller files" -> "AgieVision job files (ISO, SBR, SBL)".
  - Option group: "Wire EDM technology" -> "AgieVision technology".
  - The 17 example scripts, `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`, `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md`, `site/content/guide/operations/operations-edm.md`, and the `camcraft-mcp` skill.
- **C. Generic but with an Agie name or Agie behaviour. Make these generic.**
  - The open-cut rows and hint on the Wire page (`wire_page.rs:236-240`), and the Agie inspection section and export action: #3996 shows them only for Agie jobs. This issue only renames their texts.
  - `CommandKind::ImportAgieDrawing` does a plain DXF import. Rename it to `ImportInspectionDrawing`.
  - The old-post-name alias (`LEGACY_POST`, `current_name`, `current_ref`, `current_key`) is in `posting_agie.rs`. The project loader and the commands call it. Move it to a generic alias table.
- **D. "Generic ISO".** "Generic ISO Wire EDM" (`wire-iso.cps`) is a real generic post. No Agie item has this label. Two documents are out of date:
  - `assets/posts/AGENTS.md:322` says that `wire-iso.cps` is the only wire post. It has no section for `agie-native.cps`.
  - `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md:25` does not list the AgieVision post.

## Compatibility

- Keep the two old post names as hidden aliases: "Agie native wire EDM" and "Native wire EDM job files". The aliases apply to:
  - the document post and the setup post in project files;
  - the option keys `builtin:<name>`;
  - `SelectPost` and `SetSetupPost`;
  - the script `cps:` value, the MCP `post` tool and the CLI;
  - the `controller.post` value of a machine file.
- A save writes the new name. The project file version does not change.
- Do not change the condition ids, the MCP tool names, the CLI command, the module names or the golden folder names.
- Do not change the script receipt value `"format": "Agie native wire EDM"` (`crates/app/src/script/report.rs:81`). Scripts can read it.
- The posted job files must not change. Only line 2 of the 11 `crates/post/tests/recorded/golden/agie-native/*.refusal` files changes (the `.cps` refusal text).
- Keep the site anchor `#native-wire-edm-job-files`, or update all links to it.
- The PR changes `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. The PR body must have `Process change: yes`.

## Done means

- The post list, the post dialog, the refusals of the AgieVision post, the `.mch` description, the examples and the documents name the post "Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)" and its refusals "The Agie Wire EDM job requires ...". A text search of `crates/app/src`, `crates/ui/src`, `crates/geometry/src` and `assets/posts/agie-native.cps` finds no "native wire EDM" or "native controller".
- No generic module (project loader, commands, `posting.rs`) calls a function in `posting::agie` to resolve a post name.
- A test opens a project saved with each old post name. The test posts it and checks that the save writes the new name.
- A test pins the post list and two refusal texts.
- The posted job goldens do not change. Only line 2 of the 11 `.refusal` goldens changes.
- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` and `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md` list the AgieVision post.

Refs #3537. Related: #3996 (Agie-only controls show for jobs that are not for the Agie control).
